notes.title: Option to disable vibration/controller
notes.content:
A small quality improvement and two new features that require further testing.

[list]
[*] Goblin animation stops when there's a pop-up (pause, level finished) now.
[*] Added an option to disable gamepad vibration. [b][u]Needs to be tested on/off[/u][/b].
[*] Added an option to ignore a connected controller in the game (for example, if you have a driving wheel or a flight stick that is seen as a gamepad by mistake and interferes with the intended keyboard input, but for some reason it's not practical to unplug it). [b]Note: This will disable the use of any gamepad in the game too![/b] Should still work in menus.
[/list]

[b]Please note:[/b] Game has x-input (xbox, xbox360 and so on) controller and d-input (ps4 controller, generic d-input controllers) support natively and they should work out of the box. 

That said, steam input layer, that's usually very helpful and enables the support of any controller here on steam... might overtake the control of how gamepad is seen and works... which can cause some weird stuff. So make sure that, if steam shows you that it's loading a wrong configuration (let's say, you have x-input controller by a 3rd party and steam input configures it to "WASD+Mouse" instead of "Xbox controller"), you visit settings/controller/general controller configuration and apply a correct config for your device, or disable steam input for this game completely. See what works best for you.

notes.title: Added dialogue delays
notes.content:
Based on recent feedback, a few small changes... [i]and one no one asked for but let's try it anyway[/i]:
[list]
[*] Added 1/2 sec delay to pause/level finished screen. You can't leave them immediately anymore. 
[*] Flushing keyboard and gamepad input on leaving pause dialogue, might work differently based on hardware/software. Should prevent Goblin from jumping or running immediately after unpausing. 
[*] [i]Added some gamepad vibration and lighting (color) effects when taking damage. Don't hurt me please. [/i]
[/list]
Oh yeah, I've also updated the credits page.

notes.title: Small changes based on the initial feedback
notes.content:
I've changed some things based on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1632830/discussions/]initial feedback in the playtest hub[/url]. Let's hope these are for the better. Please continue writing your thoughts and opinions down. 

[list]
[*] Added <up> and <down> to map navigation alongside left/right. 
[*] Added a slight shadow to roofs and mushrooms where you can walk.
[*] Moved "look around" hint in the Dark mines level from the beginning to the area where the secret coins are hidden. 
[*] Worked on the crusher skull in the underground, [i]needs more testing[/i]. 
[/list]
